title: NodeRegistration
description: A provider's registration: the body of `PUT /nodes/{node_id}`, with a node token whose node is the path's. Every key is optional at the master and an unknown key is ignored; the public CLI always sends `role`, `models` and `pricing`, and leaving a grid sends `{role: consumer, models: [], pricing: {}}`. A registration WAKES a sleeping grid (it carries a credential). A node answered 404 on its heartbeat registers again.

max_concurrency.description: Concurrent requests this provider serves. Null or absent: no change. The master clamps it to at least 1.

NodeCapabilities.description: The provider's capability envelope. The master keeps it only at this schema version (otherwise it stores `{}`), and refuses it 400 unless `models`' keys are exactly the registration's `models`.

ModelCapability.description: What one model on this node can do. `endpoints` absent means chat completions only (fail-closed for the Responses dialect).

provider_attempt_tokens.description: The provider echoes `X-Grid-Provider-Attempt`; the relay then puts `provider_attempt_token` in its poll jobs.

NodeMeta.description: Presentation metadata. An empty object means "no change".

name_chosen.description: The operator chose `name`. Absent means NOT chosen, which is the private answer.
